$comment: The extensions production runs, declared in the host so the composition is
reviewable in one place rather than implied by whichever extension deployed
last. Adding one is an entry here plus a dispatch from its admission workflow.
'repository' and 'workflow' are the trust declaration: the host verifies each
signature against the identity built from these, so an extension cannot widen
who may sign for it by editing its own repository. Listing an extension grants
nothing on its own -- each is still admitted independently, and the host
refuses to boot unless the lock inventory exactly matches the enabled set.
